item.group_name: Image edits (the user brings a picture)
item.title: Match the Kitchen Window Light

turns.text: Move this candle onto a pale kitchen counter with warm sunlight coming from the upper left. Make the light on the glass and the shadow on the counter match that sunlight, so it looks actually photographed there. Keep the jar and wax the same. Square, no text.

item.tests: Tests physically consistent relighting and cast shadows during background replacement, including transparent glass edges.

answer_sheet.Subject: The candle in its clear glass jar from product-candle.jpg; preserve the jar shape and wax.
answer_sheet.New setting: A pale kitchen counter; the rest of the kitchen is your call.
answer_sheet.Lighting and shadow direction: Warm sunlight from the upper left, with corresponding glass highlights and a shadow extending toward the lower right.
answer_sheet.Style and format: One realistic square photograph at the standard free size, with no added text.

must_haves: The same candle jar and wax are preserved on a pale kitchen counter.
The original wooden shelf and nearby plant are absent.
Warm highlights on the jar are consistent with light arriving from the upper left.
The candle casts a grounded shadow toward the lower right, with no contradictory original shadow.
Transparent glass edges show the new setting naturally rather than retaining shelf or plant fragments.
The output is square with no added text.
